history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#740; borg-reborn-rs #838, #852, #837). Three arms on track-p 1c071812: ctl (shipped: caution_ranged_only 0, caution_ranged_vs_immobile 0); ranged (caution_ranged_only 1: the scary list's ranged entries kept at range, with the reach block of PR #843 as shipped on track-p); immobile2 (caution_ranged_vs_immobile 2). The earlier measurements (borg-zoo#593, #576 on 5887c29b / 3b4924ba, 900 starts: ranged 14 deaths against 11, 1 rescued / 4 newly killed; immobile2 17 against 11, 4 / 10) were on a line about 700 commits older, before breadth-first, the light radius, the #969 patch floor and the confused attack, and do not carry over. The #852 version (no reach block, resistances; borg-reborn-rs PR #1126, base main) is not on track-p and is not measured here. Each world's arms are compared only inside that world (RULES 21): the normal world, and patches-x8 (about 6 times the grey mushroom patches, the situation the setting is for). Plan: classes-18 pilots in both worlds as the gate (evidence retained), then the normal world at classes-1800 starts 1-900 (verysmall, small-rest, medium, big, read pooled) and patches-x8 verysmall.
Tier small-rest: classes-1800 small-rest, normal world, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen track-p 1c071812 with the worlds pinned (patches-x8 a6721bdd..., patches-x4 2c7da2fe...). Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell of a world records it with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report per arm, world and class: deaths and causes (floating-eye and patch deaths apart; any killer while confused or paralysed next to a listed monster), rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), CL and depth, DL3/DL5 reached, identical plays; pilot evidence: how often the listed monsters are met and what the Borg does at range. Descriptive (RULES 14).
